1. The post copy

Standard tests can miss the struggle.

Many veterans Rocio Norman treated reported trouble finding words, even when standard tests showed no clear impairment.

Researchers at the San Antonio VA already recorded veterans describing how they were injured and an important life event. A $200,000 San Antonio Medical Foundation grant funds a one year UT San Antonio pilot to analyze them with natural language processing. It looks for speech features linked to mild brain injury. The measuring is still a plan.

Today detailed language analysis takes slow transcription and coding, often by several reviewers. The tool is meant to support clinicians, not replace them.

If software can find communication differences, will they track anxiety, post traumatic stress, depression and sleep difficulties?

#SanAntonio #BexarCounty #UTSanAntonio

Notes

Carousel no. 79 tells the UT San Antonio and VA pilot that plans to read veterans' recorded speech for signs of mild brain injury. It shipped at the round cap at 7.346, under the 7.7 rung, with no hard fail in rounds 2 and 3. The art median of 7.3 is the shortfall. Frame 9 is the weakest picture. Its rework scored lower cold and was reverted to the reviewed version. Record. tx-2026-0249 admitted with fifteen claims. tx-2026-0024 and tx-2026-0218 moved (PUCT calendar, TAHC screwworm counts now 77 premises in 25 counties). Ship time. layout_check in require mode, fig_inject, the sources block and ledger topic wording each first went red at package time and were fixed. Slide 4 was re-rendered after scoring to meet the accent cap. A site build was killed by the run's own wrapper timeout and redone. November 15th. Its run record says no social publication was attempted. Upload-Post history shows all 22 placements published, no duplicates. That archive was not edited. Prompt audit (interim, before the merge). 1815 tool calls, 89 over the waiting threshold, all Agent, Bash and SendMessage latency. No-stall hook armed at 05:03:35 UTC, judged the session unattended, refused nothing.

This email is a draft. Nothing was sent by email. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Social publishing is handled by the automation; destination receipts report what actually published.
